Name: Void Machines
Author: SoftPandaBoi
Description:
All this mod really does is add two new machines to the game. One that lets you convert void items to their normal counterpart and one that does the opposite. It's a small part of something bigger that I'm planning but it's the first mod I've ever actually made so I wanted to release it individually. For now the recipes are just unlocked automatically but when I finish the full thing, they're gonna be unlocked in a NPC's event.

The available recipes are:
Large Egg <-> Void Egg
Mayonnaise <-> Void Mayonnaise
Salmon <-> Void Salmon
Mermaid's Pendant <-> Void Ghost Pendant

There's also a small chance that you'll also get an essence of the opposite type (a Void Essence if you're using the Solar Infuser or a Solar Essence if you're using the Void Infuser) instead of what you should be getting. Think of it like the machine backfiring.

If anyone has any ideas for more machines or wants functionality with any specific mods, leave it in the comments!
Also since this the first real mod I make, it might be buggy. Sorry! Just drop it in the bug reports and I'll try my best to fix it.
